**Not applicable:** the proof assessment (the request says "Proof inventory: none affected"). The formal CodeRabbit review only follows readiness, so I did nothing there.

**What's blocking it:** the plan milestones beyond EP-M1 and EP-M2 aren't implemented on this head, or no layer has a whole-plan verdict for them. That's work for the implementation owner. If this PR is one layer of a stack, it stays draft until a layer carrying the remaining milestones gets a clear whole-plan verdict for revision `rev-7`. If it's a single PR, it has to implement the rest of the plan and then get that verdict. A stack cut from one undivided plan has no route to ready under the skill, so the plan would need to be split into self-contained pieces. Asking CodeRabbit again before any new implementation work exists would add nothing, so I posted no comments and made no other changes.

I left PR 272 in draft and made no changes, based on CodeRabbit's reply in comment 9502: "This verdict covers that subset only and does not clear the whole approved plan."
